meta.name: implementing-llms-litgpt
meta.description: Implements and trains LLMs using Lightning AI's LitGPT with 20+ pretrained architectures (Llama, Gemma, Phi, Qwen, Mistral). Use when need clean model implementations, educational understanding of architectures, or production fine-tuning with LoRA/QLoRA. Single-file implementations, no abstraction layers.

copy.tagline: 用 LitGPT 实现和微调大语言模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用简洁代码实现或微调主流 LLM 架构
copy.tagline_en: Implement and fine-tune LLMs with LitGPT
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want clean implementations or production fine-tuning of LLMs

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能使用 LitGPT 加载、微调或从头训练 20 多种大语言模型（如 Llama、Gemma、Phi），并支持 LoRA/QLoRA 高效微调。
howto.when: 当你要求实现、训练或微调大语言模型，或需要理解模型架构时触发。

say.text: 用 LitGPT 加载 Phi-2 模型并生成一段关于巴黎的介绍。
say.note: Claude 会调用 LitGPT 加载模型并生成文本。

say.text: 列出 LitGPT 支持的所有预训练模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use LitGPT to load, fine-tune, or pretrain 20+ LLM architectures (e.g., Llama, Gemma, Phi) with support for LoRA/QLoRA efficient fine-tuning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to implement, train, or fine-tune large language models, or need to understand model architectures.

say_en.text: Load Phi-2 with LitGPT and generate a paragraph about Paris.
say_en.note: Claude will load the model and generate text.

say_en.text: Help me fine-tune Llama 3 8B with LoRA using my_dataset.json.
say_en.note: Claude will generate LoRA fine-tuning commands.

say_en.text: List all pretrained models supported by LitGPT.
say_en.note: Claude will run litgpt download list and show models.
